step_by_step_reasoning:
1. Identifies external inputs and visual nodes on the whiteboard: IoT Core ('IOT'), Lambda ('Lambda'), ALB ('ALB'), EKS ('BLOCKCHAIN'), DynamoDB ('DYNAMODB'), S3 ('S3'), SageMaker ('SAGEMAKER'), SNS ('SNS'), CloudWatch ('CLOUDWATCH'), CloudHSM ('KEYS'), and UserConsumerWebMobile (Users icon).
2. Traces arrows visually drawn on the board:
   - IoT Core to Lambda (data processing) and Lambda back to IoT Core (threshold control loop).
   - Lambda down to ALB, and ALB to EKS (Blockchain cluster).
   - EKS off-chain write to DynamoDB, DynamoDB down to S3, S3 down to SageMaker for predictive analytics.
   - EKS down to SNS (event-driven notification for spoiled goods), SNS to Users actor.
   - EKS bidirectional connections with CloudWatch (monitoring) and CloudHSM (key management).
3. Assigns exact service names from the allowed schema list and constructs logical sequencing across flows.

graph.name: Accenture Circulus Supply Chain Solution
graph.notes: Architecture uses IoT Core, EKS (Hyperledger Fabric), DynamoDB off-chain storage, SageMaker analytics, CloudHSM for cryptography keys, and SNS for user alerts.

nodes.name: IOT
nodes.notes: AWS IoT Core for sensor data ingestion from farms and shipments

nodes.name: Lambda
nodes.notes: Processes IoT data and evaluates thresholds

nodes.name: ALB
nodes.notes: Application Load Balancer routing requests to EKS

nodes.name: BLOCKCHAIN
nodes.notes: Hyperledger Fabric running smart contracts on Amazon EKS

nodes.name: DYNAMODB
nodes.notes: Off-chain database for real-time visualization and role-based access

nodes.name: S3
nodes.notes: S3 data lake for historical blockchain data

nodes.name: SAGEMAKER
nodes.notes: Amazon SageMaker for predictive analytics and supply chain ML models

nodes.name: SNS
nodes.notes: Amazon SNS for user and driver alerts when threshold breaches occur

nodes.name: CLOUDWATCH
nodes.notes: Monitors EKS cluster metrics and container health

nodes.name: KEYS
nodes.notes: Hardware Security Module for storing cryptographic keys

nodes.name: Users
nodes.notes: Drivers and supply chain participants receiving notifications
